title: [PATCH 12/16] net: Support multiple network namespaces with netlink

claims_extracted.claim: The core netlink conversion associated each netlink socket with one namespace but intentionally left existing netlink protocols available only in the initial namespace; requests from other namespaces received -ECONNREFUSED until each protocol was converted.
claims_extracted.notes: Strong negative evidence against treating the core merge as complete multi-namespace network-stack support.

notes: The kernel was intentionally made safe for incremental conversion rather than pretending unsupported protocols were namespace-ready.
